title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.39003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces the number of acquired projections, but conventional sampling strategies are designed primarily for image reconstruction rather than for downstream physical inference. Here, we investigate optimal task-aware projection selection for directly predicting hemodynamics from sparse CT angiography (CTA) measurements. Using computational fluid dynamics simulations of intracranial aneurysms, we generate synthetic fan-beam CTA projections and train a Fourier neural operator (FNO) to predict two targets: the spatially resolved time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS) field and the spatially averaged TAWSS. The FNO was coupled with optimal input selection for simultaneous optimal sampling and training. Our goal was to investigate if agentic AI could discover optimal sampling strategies that outperform current methods. translated_title: 智能体AI推理与学习采样用于稀疏视图CT中的任务感知投影选择：血流动力学预测
translated_abstract: 稀疏视图计算机断层扫描（CT）减少了采集投影的数量，但传统的采样策略主要是为图像重建而设计，而非面向下游的物理推断。在本研究中，我们探讨了用于从稀疏CT血管造影（CTA）测量中直接预测血流动力学的任务感知最优投影选择方法。基于颅内动脉瘤的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟，我们生成了合成的扇形束CTA投影，并训练傅里叶神经算子（FNO）来预测两个目标：空间分辨的时间平均壁面剪切应力（TAWSS）场以及空间平均的TAWSS。FNO与最优输入选择相结合，实现了最优采样与训练的同步进行。我们的目标是探究智能体AI能否发现优于现有方法的最优采样策略。我们将固定的均匀采样和黄金角采样与三种任务感知的最优选择方法进行了比较……
tldr: 该论文提出一种将智能体AI推理与学习采样相结合的任务感知投影选择框架，可从稀疏CT血管造影数据直接预测颅内动脉瘤的血流动力学（TAWSS），其表现优于传统的均匀采样和黄金角采样等固定策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic AI reasoning and learned sampling framework for task-aware projection selection in sparse-view CT, enabling direct hemodynamic prediction (TAWSS) of intracranial aneurysms from sparse CTA measurements and outperforming conventional fixed sampling strategies such as uniform and golden-angle schemes.
